<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#000}canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0}</style>
</head><body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const W=240,H=242;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(W,H);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xc6beb0);
const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(35,W/H,0.1,80);
cam.position.set(0,1.7,6.2);cam.lookAt(0,1.0,0);

const M=(c,r=0.6)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:r,metalness:0});
const mYel=M(0xfbc42c,0.5),mBelly=M(0xf6ead2,0.7),mHand=M(0x56575d,0.6),mDark=M(0x121216,0.3),
 mIris=M(0x7b8ca3,0.4),mWhite=M(0xffffff,0.2),mMouth=M(0x3a2410,0.6),mMouthSoft=M(0xc07f10,0.6);
const cSoft=new THREE.Color(0xc07f10),cDarkM=new THREE.Color(0x3a2410);
const sph=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24);
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const UP=V(0,1,0),FW=V(0,0,1);
function ell(name,mat,rx,ry,rz,x=0,y=0,z=0){const m=new THREE.Mesh(sph,mat);m.name=name;m.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);m.position.set(x,y,z);return m;}
function grp(name,parent,x=0,y=0,z=0){const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;g.position.set(x,y,z);if(parent)parent.add(g);return g;}
function limb(name,mat,a,b,r){const d=b.clone().sub(a),len=d.length();const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r,len,6,14),mat);m.name=name;m.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP,d.normalize());return m;}
function onEll(obj,rx,ry,rz,yaw,pitch,k=1){const cp=Math.cos(pitch);const p=V(rx*Math.sin(yaw)*cp,ry*Math.sin(pitch),rz*Math.cos(yaw)*cp);const n=V(p.x/(rx*rx),p.y/(ry*ry),p.z/(rz*rz)).normalize();obj.position.copy(p).multiplyScalar(k);obj.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(FW,n);return obj;}
function box(name,mat,w,h,d,x,y,z,p){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),mat);m.name=name;m.position.set(x,y,z);p.add(m);return m;}
// quaternion mapping local +Z to fwd and local +X as close as possible to side
function basisQuat(fwd,side){
 const z=fwd.clone().normalize();
 const x=side.clone().addScaledVector(z,-side.dot(z)).normalize();
 const y=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(z,x);
 return new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x,y,z));
}

/* ---------- characters ---------- */
function makeEye(name,r,lx,ly){const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;
 g.add(ell('eyeball',mDark,r,r,r*0.5));
 const look=grp('iris',g,lx,ly,0);
 look.add(ell('iris-ring',mIris,r*0.8,r*0.8,r*0.4,0,0,r*0.2));
 look.add(ell('pupil',mDark,r*0.54,r*0.54,r*0.3,0,0,r*0.42));
 look.add(ell('glint',mWhite,r*0.16,r*0.16,r*0.1,r*0.25,r*0.3,r*0.66));
 return g;}
function makeArm(c,name,sh,el,wr,rU,rF,dir,o={}){
 const a=grp(name,c,...sh);
 a.add(limb('upper',mYel,V(0,0,0),V(...el),rU));
 a.add(limb('forearm',mYel,V(...el),V(...wr),rF));
 const h=grp(name.replace('arm','hand'),a,...wr);
 if(o.side)h.quaternion.copy(basisQuat(V(...dir),V(...o.side)));
 else h.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(FW,V(...dir).normalize());
 h.scale.setScalar(o.scale||1);
 const ts=o.thumb||1;
 h.add(ell('palm',mHand,0.19,0.12,0.19,0,0,0.22));
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=-0.125+i*0.083;h.add(limb('finger-'+i,mHand,V(x,0,0.3),V(x,-0.03,0.5),0.044));}
 h.add(limb('thumb',mHand,V(0.14*ts,0,0.17),V(0.2*ts,0,0.29),0.044));
 return a;}
function makeChar(name,o){
 const c=grp(name,scene,...o.pos);
 const body=grp('body',c);
 body.add(ell('torso',mYel,1.02,1.0,0.82,0,0.3,0));
 body.add(ell('shoulders',mYel,0.8,0.62,0.7,...o.sh));
 body.add(ell('belly',mBelly,o.br[0],o.br[1],o.br[2],...o.belly));
 const head=grp('head',c,...o.head);head.rotation.set(...o.hrot);
 head.add(ell('skull',mYel,0.68,0.68,0.63));
 const eyes=grp('eyes',head);
 eyes.add(onEll(makeEye('eye-right',0.165,o.look[0],o.look[1]),0.68,0.68,0.63,-0.56,o.ep,0.95));
 eyes.add(onEll(makeEye('eye-left',0.165,o.look[0],o.look[1]),0.68,0.68,0.63,0.56,o.ep,0.95));
 const mouth=grp('mouth',head);onEll(mouth,0.68,0.68,0.63,0,o.mp,1.0);
 const lips=ell('lips',o.mm,o.mw,0.022,0.026);mouth.add(lips);
 const irises=[];head.traverse(n=>{if(n.name==='iris')irises.push(n);});
 c.userData={body,head,irises,lips};
 return c;}

const L=makeChar('character-left',{pos:[-0.95,0,-0.75],sh:[0,0.95,0],belly:[0.02,0.25,0.4],br:[0.7,0.66,0.5],
 head:[0.02,1.5,0.02],hrot:[0.02,0.07,-0.08],ep:-0.03,look:[0,-0.012],mp:-0.32,mw:0.05,mm:mMouthSoft});
const R=makeChar('character-right',{pos:[1.35,0,-0.65],sh:[-0.35,1.0,0.08],belly:[0.25,0.22,0.4],br:[0.62,0.62,0.5],
 head:[-0.73,1.72,0.2],hrot:[0.12,-0.68,0.04],ep:0.27,look:[-0.03,-0.035],mp:-0.16,mw:0.1,mm:mMouth});
L.userData.head.rotation.order='YXZ';

// left character: writing arm (viewer's left) with pen, other hand resting on desk
const LW=[0.5,-0.48,1.68];
const lArmR=makeArm(L,'arm-right',[-0.8,0.75,0.25],[-0.2,-0.4,0.7],LW,0.24,0.19,[0.5,-0.25,0.8]);
const pen=grp('pen',lArmR,...LW);
pen.add(limb('pen-body',M(0x3c3d44,0.35),V(0.19,-0.15,0.33),V(-0.02,0.39,0.1),0.024));
pen.add(limb('pen-tip',M(0xb9bcc4,0.3),V(0.21,-0.2,0.36),V(0.19,-0.15,0.33),0.012));
makeArm(L,'arm-left',[0.85,0.85,0.25],[0.26,-0.67,0.40],[0.13,-0.63,1.22],0.24,0.15,[-0.4,-0.1,0.9],{thumb:-1});
// right character: thick arm reaching over, big hand laid flat on the left character's belly
const RS=[-0.89,0.98,0.45];
const rArmR=makeArm(R,'arm-right',RS,[-0.04,-0.48,0.25],[-0.28,-0.62,0.12],0.32,0.29,[-0.92,-0.30,0.32],{side:[0,-1,0],scale:1.5,thumb:-1});
makeArm(R,'arm-left',[0.7,0.8,0.3],[0.25,-0.45,0.3],[0.1,-0.58,0.9],0.22,0.176,[-0.2,-0.2,0.9],{thumb:-1});

/* ---------- desk + props ---------- */
const desk=grp('desk',scene);
const mWood=M(0xb27a3c,0.65),mWoodD=M(0x7a4f28,0.7);
box('desk-top',mWood,7,0.14,3.2,0,-0.07,1.75,desk);
for(const x of[-3.3,3.3])for(const z of[0.3,3.2])box('desk-leg',mWoodD,0.14,2.1,0.14,x,-1.19,z,desk);
function pageTex(seed){const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=64;const g=cv.getContext('2d');
 g.fillStyle='#f6f3ec';g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);g.strokeStyle='#8d8d94';g.lineWidth=1;let s=seed;
 const rnd=()=>{s=(s*9301+49297)%233280;return s/233280;};
 for(let y=8;y<60;y+=6){g.beginPath();let x=6;g.moveTo(x,y);const end=30+rnd()*28;while(x<end){x+=2;g.lineTo(x,y+(rnd()-0.5)*2.5);}g.stroke();}
 const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return t;}
const pageMat=s=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:pageTex(s),roughness:0.85});
const nb=grp('notebook',desk,-0.45,0,1.3);nb.rotation.y=0.03;
box('cover',M(0x3b3b40),2.36,0.03,1.36,0,0.015,0,nb);
box('page-left',pageMat(7),1.12,0.03,1.28,-0.57,0.045,0,nb).rotation.z=0.03;
box('page-right',pageMat(23),1.12,0.03,1.28,0.57,0.045,0,nb).rotation.z=-0.03;
const nb2=grp('notebook-2',desk,1.5,0,1.05);nb2.rotation.y=-0.12;
box('page-left',pageMat(41),0.93,0.04,0.9,-0.48,0.03,0,nb2);
box('page-right',pageMat(57),0.93,0.04,0.9,0.48,0.03,0,nb2);
function pencil(x,z,ry,col){const g=grp('pencil',desk,x,0.025,z);g.rotation.y=ry;
 const b=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.022,0.022,0.7,8),M(col));b.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;g.add(b);
 const t=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.022,0.08,8),M(0x33302c));t.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;t.position.x=-0.39;g.add(t);}
pencil(0.45,2.0,0.12,0xe0962a);pencil(0.5,2.13,-0.05,0xd9a13a);
box('pencil-case',M(0x45464c),0.5,0.07,0.3,-1.4,0.035,2.35,desk);

/* ---------- environment ---------- */
const env=grp('environment',scene);
box('floor',M(0x9c8f7c,0.9),30,0.1,30,0,-2.25,-2,env);
box('wall-back',M(0xc9c2b4,0.95),30,14,0.2,0,3,-9.1,env);
box('wall-left',M(0xcfc9bd,0.95),0.2,14,30,-9,3,-2,env);
box('wall-right',M(0xcfc9bd,0.95),0.2,14,30,9,3,-2,env);
box('blackboard',M(0x2e4a44,0.8),7.8,2.6,0.1,2.1,4.9,-8.95,env);
box('board-ledge',M(0xcbb992,0.7),8,0.14,0.25,2.1,3.55,-8.85,env);
box('window',new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xecebe6}),3.2,3.2,0.06,-3.6,4.1,-8.96,env);
box('platform',M(0xa39683,0.9),30,1.2,6,0,-1.65,-6.1,env);
box('bench',mWoodD,5.4,0.14,1.5,0.2,-0.72,-0.75,env);
for(const x of[-2.3,2.7])box('bench-leg',mWoodD,0.14,1.5,1.3,x,-1.5,-0.75,env);
const mBT=M(0x9a6a38,0.7);
function backDesk(x,z){const g=grp('back-desk',env,x,0,z);
 box('top',mBT,2.2,0.1,1.0,0,1.2,0,g);box('panel',mWoodD,2.2,0.9,0.08,0,0.7,0.45,g);
 for(const s of[-1.05,1.05])box('side',mWoodD,0.1,2.2,0.9,s,0.1,0,g);}
backDesk(3.5,-5);backDesk(-0.4,-5.6);backDesk(-4.2,-5);backDesk(1.6,-7.6);

/* ---------- lights ---------- */
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff,0x9a8a70,1.2));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,0.45));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e0,1.7);key.position.set(-3,6,7);scene.add(key);
const back=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdfe8ff,1.0);back.position.set(4,5,-7);scene.add(back);
const side=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,0.5);side.position.set(7,2,1);scene.add(side);

/* ---------- animation (keys every 200 ms, hold 1400-1500, loop 1500) ---------- */
function kf(t,v){if(t>=1400)return v[7];const i=Math.min(6,Math.floor(t/200));const u=(t-i*200)/200;return v[i]+(v[i+1]-v[i])*u;}
const K={
 // left character: head lifts, then turns to face the right character
 lYaw:[0.07,0.03,0.08,0.76,0.82,0.86,0.86,0.86],
 lPit:[0.02,-0.02,-0.05,-0.22,-0.32,-0.38,-0.4,-0.4],
 lRol:[-0.08,-0.06,-0.04,0,0.02,0.03,0.03,0.03],
 lHx:[0.02,-0.02,-0.04,-0.15,-0.17,-0.18,-0.18,-0.18],
 lHy:[1.5,1.55,1.57,1.66,1.72,1.75,1.76,1.76],
 lIx:[0,0.04,0.045,0.035,0.025,0.02,0.02,0.02],
 lIy:[-0.012,-0.005,0,0.01,0.012,0.012,0.012,0.012],
 lMw:[0.05,0.05,0.055,0.075,0.085,0.09,0.09,0.09],
 lMc:[0.45,0.45,0.55,0.8,1,1,1,1],
 lBody:[0,0,0.02,0.06,0.09,0.1,0.1,0.1],
 lUp:[0,0.02,0.03,0.06,0.08,0.09,0.09,0.09],
 lArm:[0,-0.03,-0.1,-0.14,-0.16,-0.17,-0.17,-0.17],
 pen:[0,0.05,0.25,0.3,0.3,0.3,0.3,0.3],
 // right character: leans in, hand stays on the belly
 rLean:[0,0.04,0.045,0.04,0.04,0.035,0.035,0.035],
 rYaw:[-0.68,-0.74,-0.78,-0.82,-0.85,-0.85,-0.85,-0.85],
 rPit:[0.12,0.14,0.14,0.12,0.1,0.08,0.08,0.08],
 rHx:[-0.73,-0.8,-0.8,-0.77,-0.76,-0.74,-0.74,-0.74],
 rHy:[1.72,1.69,1.68,1.69,1.71,1.73,1.73,1.73],
 rIx:[-0.03,-0.035,-0.04,-0.04,-0.04,-0.04,-0.04,-0.04],
 rIy:[-0.035,-0.03,-0.02,-0.01,-0.005,-0.005,-0.005,-0.005],
 rArmZ:[0,-0.03,-0.05,-0.07,-0.08,-0.08,-0.08,-0.08],
 rArmX:[0,-0.01,-0.02,-0.02,-0.02,-0.02,-0.02,-0.02],
 rArmY:[0,0.08,0.1,0.1,0.1,0.09,0.09,0.09],
 rArmF:[0,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.06,0.06,0.06,0.06]
};
function pose(t){
 const lu=L.userData,ru=R.userData;
 lu.head.rotation.set(kf(t,K.lPit),kf(t,K.lYaw),kf(t,K.lRol));
 lu.head.position.set(kf(t,K.lHx),kf(t,K.lHy),0.02);
 const lix=kf(t,K.lIx),liy=kf(t,K.lIy);
 for(const i of lu.irises){i.position.x=lix;i.position.y=liy;}
 lu.lips.scale.x=kf(t,K.lMw);
 mMouthSoft.color.copy(cSoft).lerp(cDarkM,kf(t,K.lMc));
 lu.body.rotation.y=kf(t,K.lBody);
 lu.body.position.y=kf(t,K.lUp);
 lArmR.rotation.y=kf(t,K.lArm);
 pen.rotation.z=kf(t,K.pen);
 R.rotation.z=kf(t,K.rLean);
 ru.head.rotation.set(kf(t,K.rPit),kf(t,K.rYaw),0.04);
 ru.head.position.set(kf(t,K.rHx),kf(t,K.rHy),0.2);
 const rix=kf(t,K.rIx),riy=kf(t,K.rIy);
 for(const i of ru.irises){i.position.x=rix;i.position.y=riy;}
 rArmR.rotation.z=kf(t,K.rArmZ);
 rArmR.position.set(RS[0]+kf(t,K.rArmX),RS[1]+kf(t,K.rArmY),RS[2]+kf(t,K.rArmF));
}
function render(t){
 const tt=((Number(t)||0)%1500+1500)%1500;
 pose(tt);
 scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
 renderer.render(scene,cam);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref:cam},characters:[L,R],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body></html>
